tests.name: fraction_digits_empty_fraction
tests.intent: Probes parsing a floating-point number with an empty fraction immediately after the decimal point.

tests.name: fraction_digits_single_digit
tests.intent: Probes parsing a floating-point number with exactly one digit in the fraction part.

tests.name: fraction_digits_short_run
tests.intent: Probes parsing a floating-point number whose fraction is shorter than the 16-byte SSE2 chunk width.

tests.name: fraction_digits_exact_sixteen
tests.intent: Probes parsing a floating-point number with exactly 16 fraction digits matching the vector chunk size.

tests.name: fraction_digits_spanning_blocks
tests.intent: Probes parsing a floating-point number with a fraction span exceeding 16 bytes to exercise multiple vector iterations.

tests.name: fraction_digits_terminated_by_comma
tests.intent: Probes fraction digit skipping when terminated immediately by a comma inside an array.

tests.name: fraction_digits_terminated_by_bracket
tests.intent: Probes fraction digit skipping when terminated immediately by a closing square bracket.

tests.name: fraction_digits_terminated_by_brace
tests.intent: Probes fraction digit skipping when terminated immediately by a closing curly brace in an object context.

tests.name: fraction_digits_followed_by_exponent
tests.intent: Probes fraction digit skipping when followed by an exponent marker 'e'.

tests.name: fraction_digits_followed_by_uppercase_exponent
tests.intent: Probes fraction digit skipping when followed by an uppercase exponent marker 'E'.

tests.name: fraction_digits_with_whitespace
tests.intent: Probes fraction digit skipping when followed by whitespace characters.

tests.name: fraction_digits_boundary_buffer_end
tests.intent: Probes fraction digit skipping when the number ends right at the end of the input buffer without explicit terminator.

tests.name: fraction_digits_multiple_numbers
tests.intent: Probes multiple consecutive floating-point numbers containing fractions within an array.

tests.name: fraction_digits_mixed_integer_and_fraction
tests.intent: Probes numbers with large integer parts combined with large fractional parts.

tests.name: fraction_digits_negative_sign
tests.intent: Probes negative floating-point numbers with long fraction digits.

tests.name: fraction_digits_zero_fraction
tests.intent: Probes floating-point numbers with explicit zero fraction digits.

tests.name: fraction_digits_almost_sixteen
tests.intent: Probes fraction digit length just under the 16-byte vector alignment/chunk boundary (15 digits).

tests.name: fraction_digits_seventeen_bytes
tests.intent: Probes fraction digit length just over the 16-byte vector chunk boundary (17 digits).

tests.name: fraction_digits_malformed_chars
tests.intent: Probes invalid characters embedded within the fraction digits to check error path triggering.

tests.name: fraction_digits_double_dot
tests.intent: Probes malformed number containing multiple decimal points.
